mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 2.0% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 2.0% and remains below for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative GDP growth signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite rising unemployment signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative industrial production signal.
